Third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) attributable to Intel was $0.60; non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel was $0.52. Forecasting fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion; forecasting fourth-quarter EPS attributable to Intel of $0.10 and non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $0.25. SANTA CLARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Intel Corporation today reported third-quarter 2026 financial results. “Our Q3 results demonstrate improving execution, meaningful progress expanding supply and continued advancement of our process technology,” said Lip-Bu Tan, Intel CEO. “Despite near-term headwinds across the PC industry, demand for our CPUs remains robust, reinforcing our confidence in the long-term growth opportunities for our business. Our immediate priority is to unlock additional supply to meet extraordinary demand for our Xeon family, while strengthening our product portfolio and roadmap. We are moving with urgency and focus to capitalize on these opportunities to deliver sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value.” “We delivered another solid quarter. Revenue, gross margin and earnings per share exceeded guidance, including our strongest data center revenue growth in 15 years,” said David Zinsner, Intel CFO. “Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year, but we remain optimistic about the opportunities across our broader portfolio, and we will continue making disciplined investments in capacity and working capital to increase supply and support future growth.” Q3 2026 Financial Results GAAP Non-GAAP Q3 2026 Q3 2025 vs. Q3 2025 Q3 2026 Q3 2025 vs. Q3 2025 Revenue ($B) $16.5 $13.7 up 21% Gross margin 43.0% 38.2% up 4.8 ppts 44.1% 40.0% up 4.1 ppts R&D and MG&A ($B) $4.5 $4.4 up 4% $4.1 $3.9 up 3% Operating margin 15.3% 5.0% up 10.3 ppts 19.6% 11.2% up 8.4 ppts Tax rate 11.6% 6.6% up 5 ppts 11.0% 12.0% down 1 ppt Net income attributable to Intel ($B) $3.3 $4.1 down 18% $2.8 $1.0 up 169% Earnings per share attributable to Intel—diluted $0.60 $0.90 down 33% $0.52 $0.23 up 126% Full reconciliations between GAAP and non-GAAP measures are provided below. Business Highlights Company Momentum Completed a $23 billion public equity offering to support future growth opportunities while maintaining a strong balance sheet and investment-grade rating. Announced plans to acquire Classiq, combining its quantum software synthesis platform with Intel’s spin-qubit manufacturing and software expertise to create a full-stack quantum computing platform. Product Momentum Announced plans for a multiyear collaboration with Oracle intended to expand Intel ® Xeon ® -based computing on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), which is expected to span current and future Intel Xeon platforms, including planned OCI X14 offerings powered by Intel’s next-generation server processor code-named Diamond Rapids. Shared new technical details on the Intel ® GPU D-series, formerly code-named Crescent Island, introduced new Intel Xeon-based rack designs and highlighted open software and ecosystem innovations at OCP Global Summit 2026. Intel also demonstrated day-0 support for Meta's Muse Spark Open, which has been tested and is running on the upcoming Intel GPU D-series and Intel Xeon platforms. Showcased three architectures for Agentic AI and Enterprise-scale workloads at Hot Chips 2026: next-generation Intel Xeon code-named Diamond Rapids for high-performance orchestration, Intel GPU D-series for efficient inference, and Intel ® Core™ Series 3 for intelligent client and edge computing. Announced the first Googlebook devices powered by Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors with premium devices from Acer, ASUS and Lenovo, bringing together Google's next-generation computing and Intel's flagship client platform. Collaborated with AMD to bring x86 CPU optimizations for PyTorch together in oneDNN, simplifying AI development and deployment across Intel and AMD CPUs. Announced a collaboration with SAP to bridge business IT systems and the operational technology that controls physical equipment and processes through Physical AI. Foundry Momentum Released Intel 14A 0.9 process design kit (PDK) in October. Announced a collaboration with Lens Technology, combining Intel's advanced packaging expertise with Lens Technology's precision glass processing capabilities to enable advanced semiconductor packaging for the AI era. Completed the RAMP-C program, enabling validated prototypes, ecosystem readiness and early customer engagement to accelerate momentum for Secure Enclave. Announced a collaboration with ASML to accelerate industry readiness for High-NA EUV manufacturing. Collaborated with Lam Research and Applied Materials on new facilities to expand capacity and enable joint R&D in process technology and manufacturing equipment. Culture & Leadership Appointed Dean Jarnac as executive vice president and chief sales officer, leading Intel's global sales organization and strengthening customer relationships and go-to-market execution across the company's product portfolio. The gross margin and EPS outlooks are based on the midpoint of the revenue range. Earnings Webcast Intel will hold a public webcast at 2 p.m. PT today to discuss the results for its third quarter. The live public webcast can be accessed on Intel's Investor Relations website at www.intc.com . The corresponding earnings presentation and webcast replay will also be available on the site.
